note: P3 asset-derivation lineage ledgers (libs/core/information-assets/asset-derivation.ts): derivations.jsonl records source references asset:{tenant}:{id}@v{n} | path:{repo-relative} and exact source/output snapshots. system/ holds trusted producer issuance receipts as well as system-custodian lineage; only mission_controller, knowledge_steward and chronos_gateway may mutate it. confidential/<tenant>/ and personal/<ref>/ index source-custodian lineage; neither index alone grants deletion authority. derivation-deletions.jsonl audits propagated deletions, but path-only tombstones never suppress an existing artifact. Tenant offboarding follows verified transitive lineage before removing its partition; failed or unattested derived targets block clean verification and retain lineage. Removal of receipts is a reviewed decision because it severs future deletion propagation.
